meals.recipe_name: Loaded Scrambled Eggs with Cheddar Toast
recipe_steps: Crack 4 eggs into a bowl, add 2 tbsp whole milk, 1/4 tsp salt and 1/8 tsp black pepper. Whisk vigorously for 30 seconds until fully uniform and slightly frothy.
Heat a nonstick skillet over medium-low heat (about 300F). Add 1/2 tbsp butter and swirl to coat.
Add 1 cup spinach and cook 60 seconds until just wilted, then push to one side.
Pour in the eggs. Let sit 20 seconds, then use a silicone spatula to gently push eggs from edges to center, forming soft folds. Continue for 2-3 minutes until just set but still glossy.
Sprinkle 1 oz shredded cheddar over the eggs in the last 30 seconds; fold once and remove from heat.
Toast 2 slices whole wheat bread, spread with remaining 1/2 tbsp butter, and serve alongside the eggs.

prep_tasks.instructions: Mix 3 cups whole wheat flour, 1 packet (2 1/4 tsp) instant yeast, 1 1/4 tsp salt, 1 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp oil, and 1 1/4 cups warm water. Knead 8 min, proof covered 1 hr until doubled, shape into a loaf pan, proof 45 min, bake at 375F for 35 min. Cool fully and store in a sealed bag.

meals.recipe_name: Grilled Chicken Teriyaki Rice Bowl
recipe_steps: In a small bowl whisk 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp honey, 1 minced garlic clove, and 1 tsp grated ginger to make the teriyaki glaze.
Pat 8 oz chicken breast dry and slice into 1/2-inch strips.
Heat 1 tsp sesame oil in a skillet over medium-high (400F). Add chicken and sear 3-4 minutes per side until browned and internal temp reaches 165F.
Pour the glaze over the chicken; simmer 1-2 minutes, stirring, until glossy and coating the chicken.
Steam 1.5 cups broccoli in a covered pan with 2 tbsp water for 4 minutes until bright green and tender-crisp.
Reheat 1.5 cups pre-cooked rice, plate it, top with chicken and broccoli, drizzle any pan sauce, and sprinkle 1 tsp sesame seeds.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz chicken breast from freezer to fridge Sunday night for Monday lunch.
Rinse 2 cups white rice, combine with 3 cups water, bring to boil, cover, simmer 18 min, rest 10 min. Refrigerate in sealed container for use across early-week meals.

meals.recipe_name: Pan-Seared Salmon with Garlic Mashed Potatoes
recipe_steps: Peel and cube 12 oz russet potatoes; boil in salted water for 15 minutes until fork-tender.
Drain potatoes, return to pot, add 2 tbsp butter, 1/4 cup warm milk, 2 minced garlic cloves, and 1/4 tsp salt. Mash until smooth.
Pat 8 oz salmon dry and season with 1/4 tsp salt. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium-high (400F).
Place salmon skin-side down; sear 4 minutes without moving, then flip and cook 3 more minutes until internal temp reaches 125F for medium.
Add 1 cup asparagus to the pan for the last 3 minutes, tossing until tender-crisp.
Plate the mash, salmon, and asparagus; squeeze 1/2 lemon over the top.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz salmon fillet from freezer to fridge Sunday night for Monday dinner.

meals.recipe_name: Greek Yogurt Berry Protein Parfait
recipe_steps: Stir 1 scoop vanilla protein powder into 1 cup Greek yogurt until fully smooth.
Spoon half the yogurt into a glass, layer with 1/4 cup berries and half the granola.
Repeat with remaining yogurt, berries, and granola.
Drizzle 1 tsp honey over the top and serve immediately.

meals.recipe_name: Almond Butter Banana Rice Cakes
recipe_steps: Spread 1 tbsp almond butter on each of 3 rice cakes.
Slice 1 banana into thin rounds and arrange over the almond butter.
Sprinkle chia seeds and cinnamon over the top and serve.

meals.recipe_name: Protein Overnight Oats with Peanut Butter
recipe_steps: In the morning, remove the soaked oats from the fridge and stir well.
Slice 1/2 banana over the top.
Drizzle 1 tsp honey and serve cold, or microwave 60 seconds if preferred warm.

prep_tasks.instructions: Combine 3/4 cup rolled oats, 1 cup whole milk, 1 scoop vanilla protein powder, 2 tbsp peanut butter, and 1 tbsp chia seeds in a jar. Stir well, cover, refrigerate Monday night for Tuesday breakfast.

meals.recipe_name: Spicy Tuna Poke-Style Rice Bowl
recipe_steps: Drain 2 cans of tuna well and flake into a bowl.
Mix in 1 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 tbsp sriracha, and 1 tbsp soy sauce until evenly coated.
Reheat 1.5 cups pre-cooked rice and place in a serving bowl.
Dice 1/2 cucumber and 1/2 avocado; slice 1 green onion.
Top the rice with the spicy tuna, cucumber, and avocado. Garnish with green onion and 1 tsp sesame seeds.

meals.recipe_name: Beef Stir-Fry with Peppers over Rice
recipe_steps: Slice 8 oz flank steak thinly against the grain. Toss with 1 tsp cornstarch and 1 tbsp soy sauce.
Slice 1 bell pepper and 1/2 onion into strips; mince 2 garlic cloves and 1 tsp ginger.
Heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil in a wok over high heat (450F). Sear beef in a single layer 90 seconds per side; remove.
Add peppers and onion; stir-fry 3 minutes. Add garlic and ginger; cook 30 seconds until fragrant.
Return beef, add 1 tbsp soy sauce and 1 tsp sesame oil; toss 1 minute to combine.
Serve over 1.5 cups reheated rice.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz flank steak from freezer to fridge Monday night for Tuesday dinner.

meals.recipe_name: Cottage Cheese with Pineapple and Walnuts
recipe_steps: Spoon 1 cup cottage cheese into a bowl.
Top with 1/2 cup pineapple chunks and 1/4 cup chopped walnuts.
Drizzle 1 tsp honey and serve.

meals.recipe_name: Chocolate Protein Shake with Oats
recipe_steps: Add 1 cup milk, 1 scoop chocolate protein, 1/3 cup oats, 1/2 banana, and 1 tbsp peanut butter to a blender.
Blend on high 45 seconds until smooth.
Pour and drink immediately.

meals.recipe_name: Turkey Sausage and Egg Breakfast Burrito
recipe_steps: Heat 1 tsp olive oil in a skillet over medium (350F). Add 1/4 diced onion and 1/4 diced bell pepper; cook 3 minutes.
Add 4 oz ground turkey, 1/2 tsp paprika, and 1/4 tsp salt. Break apart and cook 5 minutes until browned and 165F.
Whisk 3 eggs, pour into the pan, and scramble with the turkey 2 minutes until just set.
Sprinkle 1 oz cheddar over the mixture and stir until melted.
Warm the homemade tortilla 20 seconds per side in a dry pan, fill with the mixture, fold in sides, and roll tightly. Sear seam-side down 1 minute.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 4 oz ground turkey from freezer to fridge Tuesday night for Wednesday breakfast.

Mix 2 cups flour, 3/4 tsp salt, 3 tbsp oil, and 2/3 cup warm water. Knead 5 min, rest covered 30 min, divide into 6 balls, rest 15 min more. Roll thin and cook each 45 sec per side in a dry skillet over medium-high. Store in a sealed bag in fridge.

meals.recipe_name: Chicken Caesar Wrap with Parmesan
recipe_steps: Season 7 oz chicken breast with 1/4 tsp black pepper. Heat 1 tsp olive oil in a skillet over medium-high (400F).
Sear chicken 4-5 minutes per side until 165F; rest 3 minutes, then slice.
Chop 2 cups romaine and toss with 2 tbsp caesar dressing and 1 oz grated parmesan.
Warm a homemade tortilla, layer the dressed romaine and sliced chicken down the center.
Roll tightly, slice in half, and serve.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 7 oz chicken breast from freezer to fridge Tuesday night for Wednesday lunch.

meals.recipe_name: Garlic Butter Shrimp Pasta
recipe_steps: Boil 4 oz linguine in salted water for 9 minutes until al dente; reserve 1/2 cup pasta water and drain.
Melt 2 tbsp butter in a skillet over medium heat. Add 3 minced garlic cloves and 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes; cook 1 minute.
Add 8 oz shrimp; cook 2 minutes per side until pink and opaque.
Add 1 cup halved cherry tomatoes; cook 2 minutes until softened.
Add drained pasta, a splash of pasta water, juice of 1/2 lemon, and 1 oz parmesan. Toss until glossy.
Garnish with 2 tbsp chopped parsley and serve.

prep_tasks.instructions: Cold-water thaw 8 oz shrimp Wednesday afternoon in a sealed bag submerged in cold water, ~20 min, changing water once.

meals.recipe_name: Hard-Boiled Eggs with Whole Grain Crackers
recipe_steps: Bring a pot of water to a boil, gently lower in 3 eggs, and boil 10 minutes.
Transfer eggs to an ice bath for 5 minutes, then peel.
Halve the eggs, sprinkle with salt, and serve with 8 crackers and 1/4 cup hummus.

meals.recipe_name: Vanilla Yogurt Protein Bowl with Granola
recipe_steps: Whisk 1 scoop vanilla protein powder into 1 cup Greek yogurt until smooth.
Top with 1/3 cup granola and 1/2 cup berries and serve.

meals.recipe_name: Cottage Cheese Protein Pancakes
recipe_steps: Blend 1/2 cup cottage cheese, 2 eggs, 1/2 cup oats, 1 scoop protein powder, 1 tsp baking powder, and 1/2 banana until smooth batter forms.
Heat 1/2 tbsp butter in a nonstick skillet over medium (350F).
Pour 1/4-cup portions of batter; cook 2 minutes until bubbles form, flip, and cook 90 seconds more.
Repeat with remaining batter and butter.
Stack pancakes and drizzle with 2 tbsp maple syrup.

meals.recipe_name: Pork Banh Mi Rice Bowl
recipe_steps: Slice 8 oz pork tenderloin into 1/2-inch medallions. Toss with 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp honey, and 1 minced garlic clove.
Julienne 1 carrot and 1/2 cucumber; toss with 2 tbsp rice vinegar and let quick-pickle 10 minutes.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium-high (400F). Sear pork 3 minutes per side until 145F.
Reheat 1.5 cups rice and plate.
Top with pork, drained pickled vegetables, and 2 tbsp cilantro.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz pork tenderloin from freezer to fridge Wednesday night for Thursday lunch. Optionally combine with the soy-honey-garlic marinade Wednesday night for deeper flavor.

meals.recipe_name: Bison Burger with Sweet Potato Wedges
recipe_steps: Preheat oven to 425F. Cut 10 oz sweet potato into wedges, toss with 1 tbsp olive oil, 1/2 tsp paprika, and 1/4 tsp salt. Roast 25 minutes, flipping halfway.
Form 8 oz bison into a patty; season both sides with 1/4 tsp salt.
Heat a skillet over medium-high (400F). Sear patty 4 minutes per side until 160F.
Top patty with 1 oz cheddar in the last minute to melt.
Toast the homemade bun. Assemble with lettuce, 2 tomato slices, and the patty.
Serve with sweet potato wedges.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz ground bison from freezer to fridge Wednesday night for Thursday dinner.

Mix 2 1/2 cups flour, 1 packet instant yeast, 1 tbsp sugar, 3/4 tsp salt, 1 egg, 2 tbsp butter, and 3/4 cup warm milk. Knead 8 min, proof 1 hr, divide into 6, shape into buns, proof 45 min, brush with egg wash, bake at 375F for 15 min. Cool and store sealed.

meals.recipe_name: Tuna Salad Cucumber Boats
recipe_steps: Drain 1 can tuna and mix with 1 tbsp mayo, 2 tbsp Greek yogurt, 1 diced celery stalk, juice of 1/4 lemon, and 1/8 tsp salt.
Halve 1 cucumber lengthwise and scoop out the seeds to form boats.
Fill the cucumber boats with the tuna salad and serve.

meals.recipe_name: Peanut Butter Banana Protein Smoothie
recipe_steps: Add 1 cup milk, 1 scoop vanilla protein, 1 banana, 2 tbsp peanut butter, and 1/4 cup oats to a blender.
Blend on high 45 seconds until smooth and drink immediately.

meals.recipe_name: Smoked Salmon and Cream Cheese Bagel Toast
recipe_steps: Toast 2 slices whole wheat bread and spread each with 1 tbsp cream cheese.
Layer 3 oz smoked salmon over the cream cheese; top with 1 tbsp capers and 2 tbsp thinly sliced red onion.
Heat 1/2 tbsp butter in a nonstick pan over medium; fry 2 eggs to desired doneness, 3 minutes for over-easy.
Place a fried egg on each toast and serve.

meals.recipe_name: Turkey and Avocado Club Sandwich
recipe_steps: Season 6 oz ground turkey with 1/2 tsp paprika and 1/4 tsp salt; form into a thin patty.
Heat 1 tsp olive oil in a skillet over medium-high (400F). Cook patty 4 minutes per side until 165F; add 1 oz cheddar to melt.
Toast 3 slices whole wheat bread.
Mash 1/2 avocado with a pinch of salt and spread on one slice; spread 1 tbsp mayo on another.
Layer patty, lettuce, and tomato; stack into a triple-decker club and slice diagonally.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 6 oz ground turkey from freezer to fridge Thursday night for Friday lunch.

meals.recipe_name: Chicken Tikka Masala with Basmati Rice
recipe_steps: Cube 8 oz chicken thighs and toss with 1/4 cup Greek yogurt and 1 tsp garam masala; let sit 15 minutes.
Heat 1 tbsp butter in a skillet over medium-high. Sear chicken 5 minutes until browned; remove.
In the same pan cook 1/2 diced onion 4 minutes; add 2 minced garlic cloves, 1 tsp ginger, and remaining 1 tsp garam masala; cook 1 minute.
Add 3/4 cup tomato sauce; simmer 5 minutes. Stir in 3 tbsp heavy cream.
Return chicken; simmer 5 minutes until sauce thickens and chicken reaches 175F.
Serve over 1.5 cups reheated basmati rice and garnish with 2 tbsp cilantro.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz chicken thighs from freezer to fridge Thursday night for Friday dinner.
Rinse 1 cup basmati rice, combine with 1 1/2 cups water, boil, cover, simmer 15 min, rest 10 min. Refrigerate Thursday for Friday dinner.

meals.recipe_name: Cottage Cheese and Peach Bowl with Almonds
recipe_steps: Spoon 1 cup cottage cheese into a bowl.
Slice 1 peach and add on top with 1/4 cup almonds.
Drizzle 1 tsp honey and serve.

meals.recipe_name: Chocolate Oat Protein Shake
recipe_steps: Blend 1 cup milk, 1 scoop chocolate protein, 1/3 cup oats, 1 tbsp peanut butter, and 1/2 banana on high 45 seconds.
Pour and drink immediately.

meals.recipe_name: Steak and Eggs with Hash Browns
recipe_steps: Grate 8 oz russet potato and squeeze dry in a towel. Mix with 1/4 grated onion and 1/4 tsp salt.
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium-high (400F). Press potato into a flat cake; cook 4 minutes per side until golden and crisp.
Season 5 oz flank steak with 1/4 tsp salt and 1/4 tsp pepper. Sear in the pan 3 minutes per side for medium; rest 5 minutes and slice.
Melt 1 tbsp butter and fry 3 eggs sunny-side up, 3 minutes.
Plate hash browns, sliced steak, and eggs together.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 5 oz flank steak from freezer to fridge Friday night for Saturday breakfast.

meals.recipe_name: Shrimp Tacos with Slaw
recipe_steps: Toss 8 oz shrimp with 1 tsp chili powder, 1/2 tsp cumin, and 1 tbsp olive oil.
Mix 1.5 cups shredded cabbage with 3 tbsp Greek yogurt, juice of 1/2 lime, and 2 tbsp cilantro to make slaw.
Heat a skillet over medium-high (400F). Cook shrimp 2 minutes per side until pink.
Warm 3 corn tortillas 30 seconds per side in a dry pan.
Fill tortillas with shrimp, slaw, and sliced avocado; squeeze remaining lime over the top.

prep_tasks.instructions: Cold-water thaw 8 oz shrimp Saturday morning in a sealed bag submerged in cold water, ~20 min, changing water once.

Mix 1 cup masa harina with 3/4 cup warm water and 1/4 tsp salt; knead into a smooth dough, rest 20 min covered. Divide into 6 balls, press flat between parchment, cook each 45 sec per side in a dry skillet over medium-high. Store sealed in fridge.

meals.recipe_name: Herb-Roasted Chicken Thighs with Quinoa and Veg
recipe_steps: Preheat oven to 425F. Rinse 3/4 cup quinoa, combine with 1 1/2 cups water, boil, cover, and simmer 15 minutes until fluffy.
Toss 9 oz chicken thighs with 1 tbsp olive oil, 2 minced garlic cloves, 1 tsp rosemary, and 1/4 tsp salt.
Chop 1 zucchini and 1 bell pepper; toss with 1 tbsp olive oil and 1/4 tsp salt on a sheet pan.
Place chicken on the pan and roast 25 minutes until chicken reaches 175F and veg is tender.
Fluff quinoa, plate with chicken and vegetables, and squeeze 1/2 lemon over the top.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 9 oz chicken thighs from freezer to fridge Friday night for Saturday dinner.

meals.recipe_name: Greek Yogurt with Honey, Walnuts and Berries
recipe_steps: Spoon 1 cup Greek yogurt into a bowl.
Top with 1/4 cup chopped walnuts and 1/2 cup berries.
Drizzle 1 tbsp honey and serve.

meals.recipe_name: Deviled Eggs with Whole Grain Crackers
recipe_steps: Boil 3 eggs 10 minutes, ice-bath 5 minutes, and peel.
Halve eggs, scoop yolks into a bowl, and mash with 1 tbsp mayo and 1 tsp mustard.
Pipe or spoon the filling back into the whites; dust with 1/4 tsp paprika.
Serve with 8 whole grain crackers.

meals.recipe_name: Shakshuka with Feta and Toast
recipe_steps: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium. Cook 1/2 diced onion and 1/2 diced bell pepper 5 minutes.
Add 2 minced garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin, and 1 tsp paprika; cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Add 1 cup tomato sauce; simmer 5 minutes until slightly thickened.
Make 4 wells and crack an egg into each. Cover and cook 6-8 minutes until whites are set but yolks runny.
Crumble 1 oz feta over the top and serve with 2 slices toasted whole wheat bread.

meals.recipe_name: Beef and Bean Chili Bowl
recipe_steps: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a pot over medium-high. Cook 1/2 diced onion and 1/2 diced bell pepper 4 minutes.
Add 8 oz ground beef; brown 5 minutes, breaking apart, until no longer pink.
Add 2 minced garlic cloves, 1 tbsp chili powder, and 1 tsp cumin; cook 1 minute.
Add 1 cup drained kidney beans and 1 cup tomato sauce; simmer 12 minutes until thickened.
Ladle into a bowl and top with 1 oz shredded cheddar.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz ground beef from freezer to fridge Saturday night for Sunday lunch.

meals.recipe_name: Miso-Glazed Salmon with Sesame Noodles
recipe_steps: Preheat oven to 400F. Whisk 1 tbsp miso, 1 tbsp honey, and 1 tbsp soy sauce into a glaze.
Place 8 oz salmon on a lined sheet, brush with glaze, and roast 12 minutes until internal temp reaches 125F.
Boil 4 oz soba noodles 4 minutes; add 1/2 cup edamame in the last minute, then drain.
Toss noodles with 1 tbsp sesame oil, 1 tbsp soy sauce, and 2 sliced green onions.
Plate noodles topped with salmon; sprinkle 1 tsp sesame seeds.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz salmon fillet from freezer to fridge Saturday night for Sunday dinner.

meals.recipe_name: Protein Yogurt with Granola and Banana
recipe_steps: Whisk 1 scoop vanilla protein into 1 cup Greek yogurt until smooth.
Top with 1/3 cup granola and 1/2 sliced banana and serve.

meals.recipe_name: Almond Butter Apple Slices with Cottage Cheese
recipe_steps: Slice 1 apple into wedges.
Spoon 1 cup cottage cheese into a bowl and dust with cinnamon.
Serve apple slices with 2 tbsp almond butter for dipping alongside the cottage cheese.
